JPMorgan Chase (JPM) is scheduled to report earnings on October 13, 2026, with a consensus earnings estimate of $5.88 per share on revenue of $51.85 billion. From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Financial term

Earnings are the net benefits of a corporation's operation. Earnings are also the amount on which corporate tax is due. For an analysis of specific aspects of corporate operations several more specific terms are used as EBIT (earnings before interest and taxes) and EBITDA (earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization). [...] Many alternative terms for earnings are commonly used, such as income and profit "Profit (accounting)"). These terms in turn have a variety of definitions, depending on their context and the objectives of the authors. For instance, the IRS uses the term profit to describe earnings, whereas for the corporation the profit it reports is the amount left after taxes are taken out.

Thursday, September 3, 2026, 4:05 PM ET

Zscaler (ZS) reported earnings of $1.19 per share on revenue of $898.19 million for the fiscal fourth quarter ended July 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.09 per share on revenue of $877.14 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.13 per share. The company beat expectations by 5.31% while revenue grew 24.88% on a year-over-year basis. [...] JPMorgan Chase (JPM) is confirmed to report earnings on Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at approximately 6:40 AM ET. The consensus earnings estimate is $5.88 per share on revenue of $51.85 billion, a decline of 27.9% year-over-year, and the Earnings Whisper ® number is $6.10 per share. Investors are 5.7% bullish going into the company's earnings release. Option traders are pricing in a 2.7% move on earnings and the stock has averaged a 2.4% move in recent quarters.
